protocol.selection: Existing native-policy snapshots, known-goal states at decisions 600/900/1200 and slots 0..31.
protocol.interventions: Within each model: retain native pre-input h/c or clear both to zero; independently retain or deshift the current live code, goal code, or both. Only 169 predictive slots change.
protocol.retained: Exact current visual embedding, external goal snapshot identity, previous action/reward, physical state, all network weights. No h/c cross-network swaps.
protocol.history_semantics: Zero means no carried h/c before this current input, not no prior information: external goal memory and explicit previous action/reward remain.
protocol.statistics: Four planned sensitivity contrasts; seed means use equal sampled-episode weighting. Holm correction across four contrasts, separately for t and exact sign-flip tests.
limitations: Cleared states are out of training distribution.
Action changes are not navigation performance or an optimal-action test.
